title: Conversation single-package archive runtime event payload v0.2
description: P2-13 B3 (2026-09-03, ADR-0010 §14.52 / BLACKBOARD_CONVERSATION_SCOPE_FOLD_DESIGN §12 R3): a conversation (对话 + 黑板 live 视图 + 会话元数据) was archived at session close into one gzip package under `.gsa/archives/<session8>.json.gz` — pure packaging (no content transform), atomic write + digest, original sidecars retained until the retention sweep. Each conversation is archived at most once per close; the event is the audit trace (archive_id/path/digest/status/attempts/fatigue_pct).

archive_id.description: 会话存档身份 = 会话 id + 时间戳（如 sess-abcdef12-20260903T120000Z）——不保留 plan-epoch 快照编号体系（ADR-0010 §14.52）。

digest.description: 压缩包内容的 sha256（hex，64 字符）——原子写后对成品文件计算，供回读复核；`failed` 时为空串（无成品可计）。

status.description: 存档结果：`completed` = 包已原子落盘 + digest 核对；`failed` = 重试后仍未落盘（原 sidecar 仍在，可由 retention/用户再触发）。

attempts.description: 落盘尝试次数（有界重试后上报）。

fatigue_pct.description: 会话终点黑板水位百分比（0–100；会话无黑板内容或计量失败时为 0/省略）。
